15 April 2026

Monetary Policy Report

Monetary Policy Report, April 2026.

Executive summary

CPI inflation is projected to average 2.1 per cent in 2026. Economic growth is expected to be 1.5 per cent in 2026.

This report was prepared under the responsibility of the Governing Council.

Growth in Canada and abroad

Real GDP is projected to grow by 1.4 per cent in 2026 and 1.8 per cent in 2027.

The outlook for inflation

CPI inflation is projected to average 1.9 per cent in 2027.

The labour market

The unemployment rate is expected to be 5.8 per cent in 2026. Wage growth is projected to be 3.1 per cent in 2026.

Financial conditions

Financial conditions have tightened over the past year.

Monetary policy

The Governing Council decided to hold the policy interest rate.

The Bank will continue to assess the data.

Risks

The risks to the inflation outlook are broadly balanced. Risks to growth were tilted to the upside.

Annex

Methodological notes on the projections.

Bank of Canada, 2026
